# Divider
Atlas Divider v1 — a 1px line that separates content. 2 orientations × 4 tones (8 total). The line fills its container: horizontal spans the width, vertical spans the height.

When to use: separate a title from its body, rows in a key/value list, inline links or columns (vertical). Use tone=default for ordinary separation, strong for a heavier break, subtle for a quiet one, and inverse on a filled or brand surface.
When not to use: for spacing (use gap or padding), as a decorative border around a container, or to group content that needs a visible heading (use a section title). Labelled and inset dividers are not part of v1.1.

Accessibility: a meaningful divider exposes role=separator (with aria-orientation=vertical for vertical); a purely decorative one is hidden from assistive tech. Divider has no interactive states and no motion.
